note: Spoken progress markers: Embry says what part of the answer she is working on as each stage begins, mirroring the $memory pipeline (intent -> clarify/deflect/answer/draft) so the listener hears WHERE she is instead of dead air. Stage keys map to the memory routing product the caller already emits; the router speaks a weighted-random phrase from the matching pool (session no-repeat) as that stage starts. These are short LEXICAL lines rendered LIVE on Chatterbox Turbo (<1s, tone neutral_warm/playful_light), not pre-computed clips — they can cache but do not need to. They compose with pause/thinking/hum macros: a thinking [mm], then a progress line, then the answer. Keep them short and warm; never robotic status codes.

intent.use_when: As she parses what was asked, before retrieval.
pool: Okay, let me make sure I've got what you're asking.
Right — so here's what I think you mean.
Let me get this straight first.

recall.use_when: While she looks something up or gathers evidence.
pool: One sec — checking what I've got on that.

clarify.use_when: Spoken preface right before an actual clarifying question.
pool: Hang on, I want to get one detail right first.
Let me check one thing with you —

answer.use_when: As she starts delivering the grounded answer.

draft.use_when: While she verifies before committing to a drafted answer.
pool: Let me double-check that before I say it.
Want to make sure this is right —
Give me a beat to confirm this.

working_long.use_when: Heartbeat when a stage runs long, so the wait never goes silent.
